reason: Forward-first sampling can waste fixed-reverse proposals on geometrically impossible forward spans. Enumerating the common compatible span-pair pool provides a direct, anchor-aware uniform baseline for multi-solution design and completion.
scope: 75 held-out genes, K20, 3 seeds, broad range plus 3 disjoint ranges and fixed forward/reverse: 18 runs
constraints: Identical single-oligo pool, geometry and pair delta-Tm guidance to joint learned models. Heterodimer feasibility assessed after sampling, as for learned models. No transcript/genome outcome used during sampling.
sampling_distribution: Every compatible span pair receives probability 1/total pairs. Unavailable pairs yield missing proposals; duplicates are retained.
